specTitle: Test Case 25: Verify typing in search box filters products dynamically
title: ESHOP-AC25: Verify search input filters the product list in real time when user types a keyword
preconditions: User is on the Products page and products are loaded
steps:
1. Navigate to https://ecomm-frontend-dvcdhygrandkdyhm.eastus-01.azurewebsites.net/products
2. Wait for products to load
3. Type a product name keyword into the 'Search products...' input field
4. Observe the product list as text is entered
expected: The product list updates dynamically to show only products whose names match the typed keyword; unmatched products are hidden

3. Type a search string that does not match any product name (e.g. 'xyznonexistentproduct123')
4. Observe the product listing area
expected: A 'No products found' message is displayed in the product listing area and no product cards are shown

specTitle: Test Case 36: Verify cart item shows quantity increment and decrement controls

specTitle: Test Case 37: Verify incrementing quantity updates item total in cart
title: ESHOP-AC37: Verify clicking the increment (+) button increases item quantity and recalculates item total

steps:
1. Add one product to the cart
2. Navigate to https://ecomm-frontend-dvcdhygrandkdyhm.eastus-01.azurewebsites.net/cart
3. Note the current quantity (should be 1) and item total
4. Click the increment (+) button on the cart item
5. Observe the quantity and item total
expected: Quantity increases to 2 and the item total updates to reflect 2 × unit price

4. Observe the cart content and the Cart count in the navbar

specTitle: Test Case 39: Verify subtotal updates when quantity is increased
title: ESHOP-AC39: Verify cart Subtotal in Order Summary recalculates correctly when item quantity is increased
preconditions: User has one item in the cart and is on the /cart page
steps:

2. Navigate to https://ecomm-frontend-dvcdhygrandkdyhm.eastus-01.azurewebsites.net/cart
3. Note the Subtotal in the Order Summary
4. Click the increment (+) button to increase quantity to 2
5. Observe the Subtotal value in Order Summary
expected: The Subtotal in Order Summary updates to reflect quantity × unit price (i.e. doubles for quantity 2)
